rule: Source, CLINIC WEBSITE: a first website ask gets the Doctours clinic page built from the tool's slug. Note: the packet fixture's clinic url equals its Doctours page, so this case can't catch a clinic's own site going out on the first ask until a context override gives the clinic a separate url.
Source, CLINIC WEBSITE: "the link for {clinic}" gets the Doctours clinic page.
text: Can you send me the link for Dr. Hakan Clinic?

rule: Source, PACKAGE & CLINIC FACTS can they message the clinic: yes, but ask what they need first and give no contact details.
text: Can I message Dr. Hakan Clinic directly?

rule: Source, PACKAGE & CLINIC FACTS: a mixed message needs clinic-contact and clinic-packages.
text: Can I message Heva myself, and do they do afro hair?
